result: Original strict F32 stable SiLU/product now admits exact BF16 input loads and final BF16 stores as one closed4-node cold candidate. No projection, reduction or public API change.
scope: CUDA stable gating; Windows actual runtime. No model-name switch or new executor; other dtype/layout/escape cases keep original operations.

native.scope: Source-only typed BF16/F32 stable gating suffix, no build/GPU/cache mutation
native.composition: Existing prepare_mixed_cpu_manifest + prepare_cuda_iq1_manifest, with all original IQ1 cases retained
native.correction: The first source-only freeze represented owning CUDA manifest targets, not build-composed IQ1 source. Preserved separately; no product manifest edit was required.

independent_review.scope: Independent actual source and wiring review only; no product edits, build, CUDA launch, profiling or performance run.

source_replay.composition: Both before and after use ordinary mixed CPU plus CUDA plus IQ1 composition. Composed before main 2c068e01 matches accepted v30; after 3c4fada3. Initial target-only 769ae698 is a separate source identity, not a product omission or build identity.

graph.fact: The four-node matcher requires Cast(BF16 to F32), direct marked-by-lowering F32 Unary SiLU, same-shape F32 Multiply, and final Cast to the original BF16 descriptor. Both Mul operand orders reuse the existing two-node predicate. All three eliminated values must be private; no shape broadcasting, internal metadata node, or changed public rounding boundary is admitted.

Discovery builds one existing data/control use index; one data use is required for each private value, and its control readers must be absent or inside the candidate. Published direct values are marked multiple-use; metadata-view readers retain their source edge. Every node must satisfy the normal allowed/supported mask. Common contraction still proves schedulability and retains external dependencies.

Qualification repeats exact four-node shape/type/edge checks, requires exactly the original final Cast as sole region output, and rejects escaping intermediate outputs. Two-node route 2 qualification remains available. Ordinary region and leaf fallbacks remain unchanged.

The specific four-node candidate reuses route 2 / implementation 3 / existing stable SiLU Multiply policy. Preference 199 is better than the old two-node 200; the existing search compares target misses first, then policy preference, and still permits rejected region alternatives/fallback. It introduces no model/device switch or second executor.

native.fact: Metadata admission requires four exact native CPY/Unary/Mul/CPY edges; Cast destination self-references and unused source slots are checked. Both original reads differ from all math nodes, BF16/F32/BF16 ports are exact, all shapes are equal nonempty contiguous with bounded I32 element count and bounded divisible strides. Address data is not consulted for metadata sizing.

NVIDIA and original cached launch-grid/thread caps are checked. Bound admission requires real CUDA buffers and same-device owners for both reads and final output, actual element alignment, owner capacity, and nonwrapping pointer ends. Exact or partial output/read overlaps are declined. Actual reads may not overlap eliminated intermediate payloads; unsafe cases retain ordinary native operations.

Existing private_fusion_closed requires COMPUTE and rejects intermediate OUTPUT flags. Its actual source-reference accounting includes each CPY destination self-reference; it does not rewrite use counts. Existing escaping-view traversal covers node and leaf view_src chains for all three intermediates, including raw OP_NONE view aliases. Internal View/CONT nodes prevent four-adjacent-node matching; external dense offset/reshape readers remain actual ports.

The same address-free matcher retains BOTH original BF16 z and F32 other read roots to terminal index i+3. keep follows complete view_src ancestry, and the existing allocation-plan dependency mechanism handles raw OP_NONE roots and extends lifetimes. It retains actual storage, not the eliminated F32 temporary. Bound encode repeats metadata matching, launches once and skips exactly three nodes; fusion-disabled and nonmatching domains keep the existing path.

math.source: Same BF16 load conversion exactly widens the original z to float; no projection, reduction, dot accumulation, or weight storage changes.
math.unary: New U=float prevents the old all-BF16 unary narrowing. op_hyle_stable_silu is unchanged: negative infinity maps to positive zero before multiplication, stable exp(-abs(x)) branches are retained, and ordinary float arithmetic remains.
math.multiply: The explicit float product = value * g[j1] retains the F32 multiplication boundary before final narrowing. There is no addition to contract with it and no alternative BF16 product. Other is loaded as original F32.
math.store: Only terminal __float2bfloat16_rn(product) performs BF16 RNE, matching the original final Cast boundary.
math.defaults: G, D, U default to old T. Existing F32/F16/BF16 instantiations retain their original ports and rounding; only the new private BF16/F32/BF16/U=float combination selects the new branch.
math.nonfinite: Source preserves the stable Unary special-value branch and normal IEEE F32 product, including 0*Inf -> NaN rather than skipping Mul. Source inspection does not certify NaN payload identity, signed-zero/denormal machine code, or actual device results.
